name: @getfluentfast/social-video-factory
description: Compile versioned GetFluentFast learning content into preview-ready Remotion videos.
author: GetFluentFast; motion engine based on OverlayMotion by Ricardo Metring
//exports: The engine's public surface. Consumers (the website, a customer project, the pro pack) import these paths; everything else is internal and free to move. Source is shipped as TypeScript on purpose: every consumer runs a bundler that compiles it (Vite, Remotion), which keeps one copy of the code and real types with no build step in between.
//exports.remotion: `./remotion` is the registerRoot entry, not importable app code: consumers that render headlessly resolve its path and hand it to @remotion/bundler.

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && python3 -m unittest tests/test_gff_media.py tests/test_gff_feed.py tests/test_gff_pronunciation.py tests/test_gff_pronunciation_bulk.py
scripts.gff:sample: python3 scripts/gff_media.py render --source examples/guided-communication.de.json --output renders/bakery-dialogue-preview.mp4 --props-out work/bakery-dialogue.props.json --manifest-out work/bakery-dialogue.manifest.json
scripts.gff:pronunciation-validate: python3 scripts/gff_pronunciation.py validate --source examples/pronunciation.de.ei-ie.json && python3 scripts/gff_pronunciation.py validate --source examples/pronunciation.en.th.json && python3 scripts/gff_pronunciation.py validate --source examples/pronunciation.es.g-gu-gue.json
